stem: A scheduled reading was missed, but the technician remembers approximately what the display showed. What is the strongest record practice?
choices: Backfill the remembered value at the scheduled time
Use the facility missing-data or late-entry process and do not represent a remembered estimate as the original measurement
rationale: Use the facility missing-data or late-entry process and do not represent a remembered estimate as the original measurement. This preserves the measurement, data-quality, record or role-boundary principle being assessed.
